description_en: Queries the information about instances in a manually triggered workflow
description_zh: 调用GetManualDagInstances，获取手动执行的业务流程实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-manual-dag-instances --project-env RPOD --project-name test_workspace --dag-id 7000001231241 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetManualDagInstances

parameters.help_en: The environment of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV
parameters.help_zh: 运维中心的调度环境标识，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the manually triggered workflow belongs. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Settings panel to query the name
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间名称。您可以进入DataWorks管控台，在工作空间配置页面获取
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the directed acyclic graph (DAG) for the manually triggered workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发手动业务流程运行的Dag实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html接口获取
parameters.name: dag_id
